prompt: Create a vertical editorial fashion portrait of a young woman in a gray misty studio. Show exactly 2 depictions of the same woman: one full-body figure walking forward on the left-center, and one oversized semi-transparent close-up bust portrait blended into the background on the right. The woman has dark brown loosely pinned up hair with soft face-framing strands, light eyes, natural brows, minimal makeup, small stud earrings, and a calm neutral expression looking toward the camera. Outfit: a pale blush-pink button-up blouse with sleeves casually rolled to the forearms, high-waisted wide-leg cream trousers with pleats, and clean white sneakers; one hand rests in a trouser pocket while the other hangs naturally. Use a smoky gray textured backdrop and floor, with low white fog drifting around the feet and across the lower frame, partially veiling the large background portrait. Lighting is soft, diffused, cinematic, and slightly cool, with gentle shadows and realistic skin texture. Composition should feel elegant, dreamy, and professional, like a high-end studio composite photograph, with muted pastel tones, shallow atmospheric depth, no text, no watermark, and no extra people.

promptZh: 在灰色的朦胧摄影棚中，创作一张 年轻女性 的竖版时尚编辑人像。画面中需呈现同一位女性的 2 个形象：左侧居中处是一个向前行走的全身人像，右侧背景中是一个超大尺寸、半透明的胸部特写人像。该女性留着 深棕色 的松散盘发，脸颊两侧留有柔和的发丝，浅色眼眸，自然的眉形，淡妆，佩戴小巧的耳钉，表情平静自然，直视镜头。服装：浅腮红粉色衬衫，袖子随意卷至前臂，高腰米色阔腿褶皱裤，搭配干净的白色运动鞋；一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手自然下垂。使用烟灰色纹理背景和地面，低矮的白雾在脚边和画面下方漂浮，部分遮盖了背景中的大型人像。光线柔和、漫射、具有电影质感且略带冷色调，阴影细腻，皮肤纹理真实。构图应优雅、梦幻且专业，如同高端摄影棚合成照片，色调为柔和的粉彩色，具有浅景深氛围，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。
